scope.summary: Implement StudioConstraint (hsk.studio.constraint@1) governing how a non-auto-layout child responds when its parent frame resizes: exactly one horizontal constraint (left, right, left-and-right stretch, center, scale) and one vertical constraint (top, bottom, top-and-bottom stretch, center, scale), default top-left; the scale constraint stores size/position as percentages of the parent for proportional growth; and temporarily suspending child constraints during a modifier-held parent-resize drag. Unify resizing: a child is governed by StudioAutoLayout when the parent is an auto-layout frame and by StudioConstraint otherwise; the two MUST NOT both drive the same child on the same axis, and absolute-positioned auto-layout children fall back to StudioConstraint. The constraint panel is an operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: StudioConstraint h/v/scale + suspend + auto-layout/constraint per-axis mutual exclusion; author_id + manual entry
proof_targets: Argus constraint + scale-percentage + suspend + mutual-exclusion test
expected_tests: argus: constraint panel reachable via author_id; horizontal/vertical/scale selectors
live: child repositions/resizes per constraint on parent resize; scale = percentage; suspend during modifier drag; no auto-layout+constraint on same axis

risk_if_missed: No constraint model; non-auto-layout children do not respond to resize.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
